subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `agent:turn:transcript:save` as a supported internal hook and Plugin SDK-visible ACP transcript-durability contract?
rationale: The code path is reviewable, but deciding whether this save-ordering boundary belongs in core rather than remaining unsponsored lifecycle-hook design requires maintainer product/API ownership.

options.title: Close unsponsored hook surface
options.body: Close this PR for now and ask for a maintainer-sponsored lifecycle hook design before adding the new core contract.

options.title: Sponsor and repair before merge
options.body: Accept the direction, then require the known-event registry/test fix, any public facade alignment maintainers want, and current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader lifecycle work
options.body: Keep the transcript-save idea as part of the broader lifecycle-hooks discussion instead of landing this split contract alone.

recommendation.title: Close unsponsored hook surface
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now and ask for a maintainer-sponsored lifecycle hook design before adding the new core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ACP manager and hook-contract history makes steipete the best available owner for deciding whether this core API surface should be sponsored.
